description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for copying project activities between two projects within a Human Resource Management system. It supports listing copyable activities and copying selected activities, using REST API conventions with OpenAPI annotations.

classes.name: CopyProjectActivityAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for listing and copying project activities between projects, including validation and exception handling.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list copyable activities between two projects, supporting sorting and pagination.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Handles POST requests to copy specified activities from one project to another, with validation.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the GET request parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Defines validation rules for the POST request payload.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Not implemented; throws an exception if called.

methods.name: getCommonURLValidationRules
methods.description: Provides common validation rules for URL parameters used in both GET and POST endpoints.

methods.name: getUrlAttributes
methods.description: Extracts project IDs from the URL path parameters.
